description: This Java class implements the {@link ConditionService} interface in the OpenMRS API, providing methods to handle medical condition domain objects such as retrieving, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting conditions. It interacts with the data access object (ConditionDAO) and manages transactional behavior.

classes.name: ConditionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ConditionService interface managing medical conditions in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setConditionDAO
methods.description: Setter for dependency injection of the ConditionDAO.

methods.name: getConditionDAO
methods.description: Getter for the ConditionDAO, providing access to the data layer.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a condition based on its UUID.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a condition by its internal ID.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Fetches all active conditions for a specific patient.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Fetches all conditions for a specific patient.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves conditions associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Creates or updates a condition, handling voiding and versioning logic.

methods.name: voidCondition
methods.description: Voids a condition with a provided reason.

methods.name: unvoidCondition
methods.description: Reverses a void action on a condition.

methods.name: purgeCondition
methods.description: Deletes a condition from the database.
